posts.zh:
agent-loop-workflow 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。面向 DeepSeek Harness、与具体项目无关的多智能体协作协议：阻止失控循环的循环守卫、六字段交接格式、按风险分级的评审路由，以及固定的验证→提交→推送→评审→关闭流程。用一个 skill 取代复制粘贴进每个 agent 指令里的相同规则。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b98cf5cd9eb17f35fd17.html
posts.en:
agent-loop-workflow is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A project-agnostic multi-agent collaboration protocol for the DeepSeek Harness: loop guards that stop runaway agent loops, a six-field handoff format, risk-tiered review routing, and a fixed verify→commit→push→review→close sequence. One skill instead of the same rules copy-pasted into every agent's instructions.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b98cf5cd9eb17f35fd17.html
